name: softrest
_note: a hand RESTING on her (the bump, a thigh) seen side-on: the fingers softly together, each a little curled so they follow the curve under them, more toward the little finger, the tips just apart; the thumb along the top. With fx.fingersIn 0.3 (on the bump) to 0.5 (round the bump's underside, on a thigh). 'siderest' (10–12° every finger, one angle) read as fingers 'pointed directly out at a specific angle' (Harry, round 8)
